Questions people ask

How many services does a package cover?

Each package covers 3 services.

What is the difference between the packages?

Package A uses 6L of Liqui Moly Top Tec ($628). Package B uses 6L of Castrol Edge ($528). Both include a Liqui Moly engine flush, oil additive and injection cleaner, and a 50ml Liqui Moly windshield cleaner. Package C uses 4L of Castrol Edge ($428) without the flush bundle or windshield cleaner.

What if my car needs more oil?

Extra oil is $29 per litre on Package A and $20 per litre on Packages B and C.

Which oil grades can I choose?

5W-40, 5W-30 or 0W20.

Is brake fluid included?

Brake fluid flushing is done only when brake pads are changed.

Is there anything after the 3 services?

Package customers get lifetime free checking.
